decisions.reason: Because this sheet preparation module extends the firm's established modular workflow offer and no clear below-aspiration signal is visible after another year, management would keep it.
As a flagship B2 multifinisher closely aligned with the firm's automation direction and core postpress business, it is very unlikely to be judged a poor enough use of resources to withdraw now.
The folding add-on unit has early customer-use evidence and fits the installed base well, so boundedly rational management would usually retain it unless performance worsens clearly.
